programme.title: Fudbal - Španska liga: Osasuna - Athletic Bilbao 07.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Evropsko prvenstvo U19: Crna Gora - Srbija
programme.desc: Kvalifikacije za Evropsko prvenstvo U19 okupljaju najperspektivnije mlade fudbalere Evrope u borbi za mjesto na završnom turniru. Gledaoce očekuju zanimljivi dueli, veliki talenti i uzbudljiva borba za plasman među najbolje omladinske selekcije kontinenta.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroliga: Maccabi - Olympiacos
programme.desc: Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svijet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju mijenjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. programme.desc: Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svijet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. programme.title: Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka: Wisla - Veszprem
programme.desc: Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun plays the replacement hired for a popular band whose egotistic drummer quit to join a rival group.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master named 'Shadow Whip', he is suspected and hunted.

programme.title: Swordsman At Large
programme.desc: Bandits, beauties, and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist kills his master and entire clan, the Iron Buddha sets out for revenge. He'll need a magic sword first though, naturally.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Beloved cult director Kueh Chih Hung delivers this deranged romantic tragedy centring on muscular demon Lo Meng, whose attempts to possess the soul of his true love backfire.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score 'The Proud One'. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Tang Peng Nan are a sweet couple. She sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan at a time when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by him, leading to their break up.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: Wang Yu plays a noble martial arts student, whose master and peers are murdered by Lo Lieh's bloodthirsty karate expert, and embarks on a tough training regime to avenge them.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A sickly wife and maid conspire to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: When the Emperor is killed and the throne is usurped by Lord 9, his two baby princes are entrusted to the care of three Shaolin monks and the premier.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Word gets out that blind Ku has the secret of the Buddha's Palm and he is besieged by everything from terrifying giant birds to gangs of martial arts warriors.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life!

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is one of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When he starts to question the morality of his missions, he becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, a heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers! In this musical drama, Julie Yeh Feng stars as Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl who falls in love with a handsome boatman named Liu Ta-lung

programme.title: Danger Has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My 12 Lovers?
programme.desc: Six guitar playing, rock and roll singing and dancing young people on a boating trip are stranded on a rural island off of Hong Kong during a typhoon. They become suspicious of a woman (Jenny Hu) who matches the radio bulletin description of a murderess who killed twelve men. Can she be trusted? Is she laying a trap for a local youth (Chin Han) housesitting a mansion?

programme.title: The Bells Of Death
programme.desc: Amidst fountains of blood and guts, The Bells Of Death is a whirlwind story about a man embarking on a lifes journey to learn the sword, then gain revenge on the three men who killed his family and abducted his sister.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: After his hit directorial debut Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns with this comedic clash of cultures when a Mainland Chinese peasant takes his family to Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: When an Anti-Ching chief is killed, his family flees to a small town populated by quarreling students and formidable gym coaches. However, one teacher is also an undercover agent.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang wrote and directed Tales of Larceny, a story of scams and deceit during the corrupt Chinese Warlord era, featuring top character actors from Shaw Brothers' roster.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Danny Lee, Jason Pai and Sun Chien play newly-recruited law enforcers whose crime-fighting is hampered by their corrupt superiors, in this period-set martial arts thriller.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David is falling in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming. Out of jealousy, Mona lies to him about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng.

programme.title: Tales Of A Eunuch
programme.desc: The story follows a 'loveable' rascal as he gambles and gets into various bits of trouble with outlaws and rebels. The whole movie revolves around a quest for all the copies of a special Buddhist text.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: An amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry from Li Han Hsiang, recreating some of the era's funniest and most surreal stories ripped straight from the gossip.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei was Hong Kong's most celebrated Queen of Kung-fu. Here she plays a swordswoman on a mission to avenge her parents murders and save the country from foreign invaders.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husband's murder by the rapist.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: A frustrated young man afflicted with polio works as a paralegal for a corrupt lawyer. He gets passed onto him the technique for a strange power by a dying man, which turns him into an oil based superhero/villain.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A brainy private school student is transferred to a far less elite institution, where he must fend off classmates who settle scores with fistfights.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Love In A Fallen City
programme.desc: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. His pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered. Can he avenges his brother's death?

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot! (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A crooked but highly successful lawyer takes on a complicated case of murder, after his martial arts expert wife insists on it, which involves him going up against a few corrupt judges.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveller (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Behind The Yellow Line

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Nobody 2

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon

programme.title: Downsizing

programme.title: Ep12 : The Catch-Up Show
programme.desc: The Catch-Up Show is your chance to relive the 'best bits' from across the Premier League week with a compilation of all PLP content and programming.

programme.title: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink : PL Moments
programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments from his Premier League career.

programme.title: Petr Cech : PL Stories
programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Cech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: The Evolution Of Goalkeepers : PL Stories
programme.desc: Once the last line of defence, today's goalkeeper is expected to be so much more. From sweeper-keepers to playing out under pressure, we explore the innovations, characters and changing demands that have revolutionised one of football's most fascinating positions.

programme.title: Mw10 : Netbusters
programme.desc: A fast-paced music and commentary driven ISO angle highlights show featuring every game and every goal from each match round.

programme.title: Michael Owen: My Breakthrough Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: Theo Walcott: My Premier League Years : Rewind
programme.desc: At just 16 years old, Theo Walcott attracted the attention of Arsene Wenger, who brought the electric youngster to Arsenal. The Englishman bagged over 100 goals for the Gunners, becoming one of their most prolific Premier League stars. He recalls the key moments and matches from 12 years in north London.

programme.title: Mikel Arteta : PL Stories
programme.desc: We explore Mikel Arteta's impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops players and the standards he sets throughout the club. We look at the key decisions that have turned Arsenal into Premier League champions.

programme.title: 2016/2017 (Che) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: A review of all the best goals, action and drama from Premier League seasons past.

programme.title: 2016/2017 (Gb: Kane) : Goals Of The Season

programme.title: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink : PL Moments
programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments from his Premier League career.

programme.title: Marc Guehi : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Marc Guehi arrived at Manchester City as an FA Cup winner with Crystal Palace before winning the same trophy with his new club 12 months later. The centre-back sits down with The Big Interview to talk about becoming a key figure in Enzo Maresca's team, as well as how a love for music has formed a key part of his life.

programme.title: Rio Ngumoha : The Big Interview
programme.desc: At just 16 years and 361 days old, Rio Ngumoha became Liverpool's youngest ever goalscorer, scoring a 100th minute winner on his Premier League debut at Newcastle. The records kept on falling in the 2025/26 season as the young winger went from wonderkid to first team regular. The East Londoner reflects on his meteoric rise and the importance of family support along the way.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: Alan Shearer : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Alan Shearer reflects on a childhood where his eye for goal came naturally, and led to a career that ended with him setting a Premier League goalscoring record that remains unchallenged. The former Southampton, Blackburn and Newcastle man explains what makes a great striker, and reveals a piece of advice that he's passed on to a Premier League star of today

programme.title: Aston Villa 92-93 - Behind The First Season : PL Stories
programme.desc: Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson's Villa, revealing the characters, camaraderie and mounting pressure of a gripping title challenge. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.

programme.desc: Peter and Kasper Schmeichel explore how the art of goalkeeping has evolved throughout the Premier League era. Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Jangan Bercerai Bunda (RR)
programme.desc: Nabila adalah seorang ibu dan wirausahawan yang memiliki tiga orang anak. Dalam kehidupan rumah tangganya bersama sang suami, Arga, berbagai lika-liku pun muncul. Terungkapnya perselingkuhan Arga dengan wanita lain membuat Nabila dihadapkan pada situasi yang penuh dengan pilihan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Series yang ditayangkan malam hari. Series dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan.

programme.title: Seputar iNews
programme.desc: Program berita yang menyajikan rangkuman berita-berita penting dan terkini yang terjadi di dalam dan luar negeri. Dari politik, ekonomi, hukum, hingga peristiwa sosial dan olahraga, semua dikupas tuntas di sini.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Putri Untuk Pangeran (RR)
programme.desc: Putri adalah anak dari seorang wanita baik hati yang tidak menyadari bahwa dirinya merupakan keturunan malaikat. Demi membantu perekonomian keluarga, Putri bekerja keras hingga akhirnya bisa menempuh pendidikan di universitas. Ibunya adalah seorang orang tua tunggal. Berkat darah malaikat yang mengalir dalam dirinya, Putri memiliki kemampuan untuk mendengar suara hati setiap orang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Tanpa Karena (RR)
programme.desc: Perjalanan cinta Nuna dan Dipta harus menghadapi jalan yang terjal. Mulai dari terhalangnya restu orang tua, jarak yang memisahkan, hingga rasa cemas karena Dipta merupakan seorang abdi negara yang setiap harinya harus mempertaruhkan nyawa. Berbagai rintangan pun menguji kesetiaan cinta mereka.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Amira, seorang wanita berhati baik yang hidup bahagia bersama suami dan anaknya, harus menghadapi tragedi setelah Aditya berselingkuh. Suami dan putranya tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan, begitu pula bayinya. Amira pun terpuruk dalam duka yang mendalam.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Werder Double
programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: 1. FSV Mainz 05 - FC Bayern Monachium
programme.desc: W poprzedniej ligowej kampanii Mainz potrafiło postawić Bawarczykom trudne warunki. Die Roten wywieźli co prawda z Mewa Areny cenne zwycięstwo, lecz Zero-Piątki strzeliły im aż trzy gole (4:3). Trzymamy kciuki, by w 9. kolejce sezonu 2026/27 obie ekipy stworzyły równie ciekawe widowisko.

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne
programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.

programme.title: Birds of paradise
programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.title: Najszybsze gole Bundesligi

programme.title: Legendy ligi niemieckiej
programme.desc: Rudi VoellerBiografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Cagliari Calcio - Frosinone Calcio
programme.desc: Frosinone jest jedną z niespodzianek pierwszej części sezonu. Obecnie znajduje się na szóstej lokacie i traci zaledwie 3 punkty do miejsc pozwalających na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Przybliżyć się do nich chce starciem z notującym spadek formy Cagliari. Zespół z Sardynii przegrał 4 ostatnie mecze ligowe i spadł na dwunastą pozycję.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Toulouse FC - RC Strasbourg
programme.desc: Strasbourg w poprzedniej kolejce ograł Auxerre 5:1 i tym samym wydostał się ze strefy spadkowej. Teraz chce rozpocząć pogoń za ligową czołówką, do której traci 5 punktów. Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - Atalanta BC
programme.desc: Atalanta od początku sezonu miała bić się o miejsca pozwalające na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Jednak zamiast pierwszej czwórki bliżej jest strefy spadkowej, nad którą ma 4 oczka przewagi. Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Hamburger SV - Borussia Mönchengladbach
programme.desc: Podopieczni Merlina Polzina są w słabej dyspozycji - przegrali dwa mecze z rzędu. W poprzedniej kolejce ulegli na wyjeździe Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 1:3. W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. Gospodarze nie mogą jednak zlekceważyć przyjezdnych, zwłaszcza że ci punktowali w dwóch poprzednich meczach. Najpierw wygrali 3:2 z VfB Stuttgart, a następnie bezbramkowo zremisowali z SC Paderborn 07.

programme.title: Werder Double
programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole VfL Wolfsburg
programme.desc: Edin Dżeko, Grafite, a także Andrzej Juskowiak to tylko trzech wybitnych napastników, którzy zdobywali gole w barwach Wolfsburga. W szeregach tej drużyny występowało bowiem wielu klasowych snajperów. W programie zobaczymy najładniejsze bramki zdobyte przez piłkarzy Wilków.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio
programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Moi bohaterowie
programme.desc: Joshua KimmichJoshua Kimmich to jeden z najzdolniejszych defensywnych piłkarzy młodego pokolenia w Niemczech. Jest filarem Bayernu Monachium i reprezentacji Niemiec. To jeden z tych zawodników, do których należy piłkarska przyszłość.

programme.title: Legendy ligi niemieckiej
programme.desc: Rudi VoellerBiografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Cagliari Calcio - Frosinone Calcio
programme.desc: Frosinone jest jedną z niespodzianek pierwszej części sezonu. Obecnie znajduje się na szóstej lokacie i traci zaledwie 3 punkty do miejsc pozwalających na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Przybliżyć się do nich chce starciem z notującym spadek formy Cagliari. Zespół z Sardynii przegrał 4 ostatnie mecze ligowe i spadł na dwunastą pozycję.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - Atalanta BC
programme.desc: Atalanta od początku sezonu miała bić się o miejsca pozwalające na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Jednak zamiast pierwszej czwórki bliżej jest strefy spadkowej, nad którą ma 4 oczka przewagi. Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Hamburger SV - Borussia Mönchengladbach
programme.desc: Podopieczni Merlina Polzina są w słabej dyspozycji - przegrali dwa mecze z rzędu. W poprzedniej kolejce ulegli na wyjeździe Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 1:3. W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. Gospodarze nie mogą jednak zlekceważyć przyjezdnych, zwłaszcza że ci punktowali w dwóch poprzednich meczach. Najpierw wygrali 3:2 z VfB Stuttgart, a następnie bezbramkowo zremisowali z SC Paderborn 07.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Toulouse FC - RC Strasbourg
programme.desc: Strasbourg w poprzedniej kolejce ograł Auxerre 5:1 i tym samym wydostał się ze strefy spadkowej. Teraz chce rozpocząć pogoń za ligową czołówką, do której traci 5 punktów. Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.title: Werder Double
programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole VfL Wolfsburg
programme.desc: Edin Dżeko, Grafite, a także Andrzej Juskowiak to tylko trzech wybitnych napastników, którzy zdobywali gole w barwach Wolfsburga. W szeregach tej drużyny występowało bowiem wielu klasowych snajperów. W programie zobaczymy najładniejsze bramki zdobyte przez piłkarzy Wilków.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Vitoria SC - FC Porto
programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.desc: The largest and most popular league of American football in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best conference teams each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most covered sports event on the planet.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Dubai - Efes
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Rukomet - EHF Liga šampiona: Kielce - Barca
programme.desc: Rukometna Liga šampiona svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu šampiiona uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama menjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Košarka - VTB liga: Uralmash - Lokomotiv, G3
programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia also participate in the league. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, of which the best placed becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013.

programme.title: Rukomet - EHF Liga Evrope: Pregled 4. kola
programme.desc: EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gde klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u knock out fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dve utakmice između protivnika sledi final four. Polufinale i finale kao i utakmica za treće mesto se igraju na jednu dobijenu utakmicu.

programme.title: Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Galatasaray - Legia
programme.desc: Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Košarka - Eurocup
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kup Srbije: Tekstilac - Železničar
programme.desc: The Serbian Cup is the second most important and powerful football competition in Serbia, which has been played under that name since 2006. During Yugoslavia, Serbian clubs played cup competitions with other republics of the former state, while from 1991 to 2006, Serbian and Montenegrin clubs played. After the end of the existence of the state of Serbia and Montenegro, the Cup of Serbia was created. At one time, this competition was named after the sponsor, and the final is played on one game won. The host city and the stadium of the final are known in advance.

programme.title: Fudbal - Brazilska liga
programme.desc: Serija A (port. Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A) je najviši nivo fudbalskog takmičenja u Brazilu. Trenutno, ovo takmičenje je sastavljeno od 20 timova, a po završetku sezone, najslabija 4 tima idu u niži rang takmičenja, (Seriju B), a iz Serije B najbolja 4 dolaze u Seriju A.

programme.title: Fudbal - Brazilska liga: Vasco - Internacional
programme.desc: Brasileirao Seria A is the first Brazilian league founded in 1959. Due to geographical reasons, the history of the single league in Brazil is relatively short. Only with the development of civil aviation did Brazil get a unique football league. There are currently 20 teams participating in the league in a two-round competition system. During its existence, Serie A has given the soccer world some of the best players in history. Pele, Socrates, Garrincha and Ronaldinho are just one of them. The extremely attacking and attractive orientation of the game and the fanatical and numerous support from the stands are the reason why Serie A is one of the most exciting competitions on the planet.
